newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunkers stable, levels may fall later.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunkers stable, levels may fall later.

text.p: Singapore bunker supplies were quoted at around their recent levels on Thursday and traders expected moderate trade later in the day.

Bunker 380-cst supplies were quoted at above $100 per tonne. "But some may sell at $99 later just to make sure they get the business," said one supplier. The 180-cst grade was offered at $103/$104 per tonne.
MDO and gas oil stabilised at around $160/$163 and $170/$175 per tonne respectively. --Singapore Newsroom (65-870 3571)
